content: {DRAFT} If Ethernet frames without a VLAN tag (untagged Ethernet frame) which are received on a particular Ethernet port shall be dropped, then the parameter EthSwtPortIngressDropUntagged of this Ethernet port shall be set to TRUE and the parameters EthSwtPortIngressDefaultVlan and EthSwtPortIngressDefaultPriority of this Ethernet port shall not be con- figured (multiplicity of both parameters are 0 )
